data.name: Sharwanraj
data.gender_notes: Sharwanraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharwanraj is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'sharva' (auspicious, glorious) and 'raj' (king). It is a name evoking the themes of victory, power, and kingship. The name Sharwanraj carries the meaning “King Sharavan” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Marathi. Parents who choose Sharwanraj usually hope their child will grow to embody king sharavan and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwanraj is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of strength, courage, and wisdom. It is believed to bring good fortune and success to those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Sharwanraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King Sharavan.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwanraj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: Sharwanraj is a variant of the name Sarvanarajan, which means 'King of all'. This name was popular during the medieval period in India, particularly among the rulers of the southern Indian dynasties such as the Cholas and the Pandyas.

The name Sharwanraj is also associated with Sharwana, a goddess in Hindu mythology. She is considered to be the goddess of fertility and agriculture. In some traditions, she is also known as Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth. The name Sharwanraj may have originated as a reverential title for this goddess during rituals and celebrations.
